HEADLINE.pre_registered_primary: WORKS — COMPLEMENTARITY CONFIRMED. R2 (RAFT+top5) coverage@0.5=0.809 vs R0 (base+top5)=0.728, Δ=+0.081 (McNemar χ²=22.2, 52 fixed/13 regressed, p≈0; Wilcoxon on 3-level score p=1.5e-7). Gain concentrates on retrieval-MISSES: Δ_miss=+0.162 vs Δ_hit=+0.028, diff-in-diff=+0.135, 95% CI [0.062,0.206], p=0.0003. Holds on clean (non-leaked) subset: n=406 Δ=+0.071 χ²=14.8 p<1e-4. DiD lower CI 0.062 > §9 ~0.038 artifact bound.
HEADLINE.mechanism_evidence: Parametric fallback is the dominant mechanism for the miss-fixes (DIRECT discriminating test): among the 112 misses R0 fails, R3 (closed-book) covers 68.4% of the 38 facts R2 RESCUES vs only 24.3% of the 74 R2 also fails (base R3-over-all-misses 47%). R2 rescues precisely the misses the model knows in its weights — ~3x enrichment.
HEADLINE.exploratory_R2_vs_R1: POST-HOC / EXPLORATORY (NOT pre-registered; §8 pre-registers only R2-vs-R0, R1-vs-R0, R3-vs-R1). Isolating the training OBJECTIVE (R2 vs R1, same 60k QA): miss coverage near-identical (R2 0.576 vs R1 0.571) — parametric miss-recall comes from the 60k, which plain-QA FT already achieves. Plain-QA FT INTERFERES on hits (R1 0.834 vs R0 0.934, −0.100, χ²=21.2 p≈0); RAFT REMOVES it (R2 0.962 vs R1, +0.128, χ²=33.2 p≈0, 38 restored/1 lost). DiD(R2 vs R1)=−0.122 CI[−0.196,−0.050] p=0.001; Wilcoxon p=5e-9. READ AS: RAFT's distinctive effect is undoing the grounded-reading damage plain FT causes — NOT adding parametric knowledge. CAVEATS: (a) R1+top-5 is itself length-OOD — R1 trained on question-only prompts (max_length 71) and never saw retrieved context, so its hit-side drop mixes 'plain FT degrades reading' with 'R1 never trained on context'; (b) not exactly data-matched — R2 dropped 3,258 long packed examples whose hit/miss skew was never measured (§5.4).
HEADLINE.secondary_closedbook_R3_vs_R1cb: R3 (RAFT closed-book)=0.462 < R1cb (plain-QA closed-book)=0.528, Δ=−0.067 p=0.005 — RAFT's raw closed-book recall slightly WORSE than plain-QA's. Directional only (R3 is OOD for R2, always trained WITH context).
HEADLINE.judge_validity: Blind same-session Opus, 10 shards, 0 blindness breaches, per-shard provenance verified, q/gold identical across all 5 arms. Rubric was RECONSTRUCTED (standard 3-way CORRECT/PARTIAL/INCORRECT + content-only clause), not taken verbatim from Phase-1. CROSS-SESSION DRIFT measured directly: R1cb is byte-identical text to the Phase-1 promotion arm, scored 0.461 there vs 0.528 here = +0.067 drift (2x the ~0.03 in memory). => Absolute coverage levels here are NOT comparable to Phase-1 numbers; only WITHIN-session deltas are valid (all contrasts above are within-session).
HEADLINE.caveats: 13/481 eval prompts exceed R2's 1207-tok training length (mild OOD). 2nd seed NOT needed (not AMBIGUOUS).
